👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Doston, 10 saal pehle hamare legendary Ajit Doval sir ne Pakistan se kaha ki agar Pakistan ek aur attack Bharat par karega, toh Pakistan Balochistan kho dega!

Aur aaj ye baat sach hone ja rahi hai! Doston, Pakistan chaaro dishaon se barbaad hone ja raha hai! Aur is baar Pakistan ka dushman Bharat nahi, Pakistan ke khud ke log hain! Ye log ab Pakistan ke partition ki tayaari kar rahe hain! Aur in logon ka naam hai Balochistan Liberation Army!

Doston, kaafi logon ko lagta tha ki Balochistan ke log chhote-mote rebels hain, lekin aaj Balochistan Liberation Army itni taqatwar ban chuki hai ki Balochistan ne Pakistan se azaadi declare kar di hai.

Aur ye rebellion Pakistan ko isliye barbaad kar sakta hai kyunki Balochistan Pakistan ki zameen ka 44% hissa hai, yahaan par 83 lakh crore ke natural resources hain, yahaan tak ki Pakistan ka 25% gas supply bhi Balochistan se hi aata hai! Aur agar Balochistan Pakistan se alag hota hai, guess what? Bharat ke liye ek jackpot ho sakta hai!

Toh doston, sawaal ye hai ki:
Balochistan Liberation Army hai kya?
Balochistan ke log Pakistan se azaadi kyun lena chahte hain?
Aur Balochistan ki is bagawat se Bharat ko kya fayda ho sakta hai?

Janenge iss Episode me!
